trends towards. $^{3}$

$^{2}$ Because DALL·E 3 is called via a tool call, sometimes a user prompt may never cause a tool call. We normalize all numbers so they sum up to 100%.
$^{3}$ Shannon entropy is a metric from information theory that quantifies uncertainty or unpredictability in a distribution. Low entropy (0) means the distribution is highly skewed — nearly all predictions fall into one class. High entropy (1) means the distribution is uniform — the model is equally likely to assign any class.
